Suncor Energy Inc. (2025). Suncor MacKay River In Situ Project: 2024 Directive 54 Performance Report. Commercial Scheme Approval No. 8668. Reporting period 1 January to 31 December 2024. Annual performance presentation filed with the Alberta Energy Regulator, 30 June 2025.

Loaded: 2024 scheme bitumen production (annual-output from 5,133 m3/d x 366 d), steam per m3 bitumen (flow, from 15,449 m3/d CWE), descriptions for the scheme and its NCG co-injection. Other-values: SOR 3.01, capacity and steam limit read from the slide 26 chart, recovery, new pad, turnaround dates. The deck follows the revised Directive 054 template (2025): it has no energy-balance, fuel-gas, electricity, cogeneration, GHG, water-balance or steam-generator slides, so no specific-energy-consumption, emissions or water-treatment rows could be written. No solvent co-injection at MacKay River (HOLLER trial cancelled, slide 32). Skipped: subsurface, geomechanics, seismic, well suspension, regulatory and compliance tables; 99.75 m3 lagoon-fluid disposal pilot. Locator convention: slide numbers printed, equal to PDF pages. Traps: (1) reporting year 2024 although the file is named 2025; (2) leap year, 366 days; (3) a month-long turnaround (Sep 2024) depresses the annual average; (4) operator legal name not printed, only "Suncor".
